headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Total sales volume increased 8% YoY to 925.59 MMSCM, with average daily sales reaching a record 10.06 MMSCMD.
CNG volumes grew 9% YoY to 696.63 MMSCM, while PNG volumes increased 6% to 228.66 MMSCM, driven by 16% growth in domestic PNG.
However, elevated gas procurement costs pushed consolidated EBITDA into a loss of ~INR 32 crore, with margins at -0.6%.
Net profit declined ~94% YoY to INR 23.75 crore, reflecting significant profitability pressure despite robust operational growth.
valuation: Management remains focused on restoring EBITDA/SCM while targeting double-digit volume growth, although near-term margins remain vulnerable to elevated LNG prices and geopolitical disruptions.

Return on Equity is expected to reach 11.8% and RoIC is expected to reach 15.1% Valuation call: We recommend a BUY with a price target of INR 159 (11.1X P/E FY29) from the CMP of INR 133 representing an upside of 20%.
